title: the install copied the bundle off the stick before loading it

findings.claim: a first install copied every payload of the bundle into TMPDIR twice (the dry run, then the load) and the weights once more into the models folder: the peak was about the bundle plus everything loaded
findings.severity_basis: the walk's install on the bench host stopped at step 1 for disk: 79 GB free fell to 14 GB on a 60.7 GB bundle
findings.fix: the verifier stages no image and no weight; the update path loads each straight from the bundle and hashes it again on the way in; tests/unit/test_load_from_the_stick_h95.py measures the peak
findings.from: the integrator's card H-95 (comments 7092830629, 7092940586) and the walk of 2026-11-23

findings.claim: what a real docker load writes in passing inside Docker's data root (the archive unpacked before the image is registered, or compressed layers kept beside the unpacked ones) is not measured: the peak on a real box may pass the installed size plus 10 % while the largest image loads
findings.severity_basis: the bound is held on this card's own writes; Docker's are outside it and depend on the image store
findings.fix: not in this card: the rehearsal job or the bench measures the disk during a real install of the two packs

findings.claim: a first load (the box not running) that fails on one payload's hash leaves the payloads loaded before it in place; only the failing payload and the pack's record are not written
findings.severity_basis: a re-run of the install loads again and the box does not start on a partial load, but a person reading the disk sees a half-loaded pack
findings.fix: not in this card: the first-install branch of tools/trialbox/update.py main_apply has no rollback point, as before

findings.claim: a model pack applied to a running box keeps every weight file it overwrites aside in the rollback point under deploy/updates: that update's peak is the installed size plus the old weights
findings.severity_basis: a model pack changes rarely (the pair or the engine), and the copy is what the rollback needs

findings.claim: the bench's size breakdown of the bundle (each image compressed and loaded, each model folder, where the disk went) was not found on #639; the peak test's proportions are this card's assumption
findings.severity_basis: the bound is a ratio, held whatever the proportions; the targets for the packs' sizes are not checked
findings.fix: not in this card: the bench's line, then the sizes on the install page
